plan.title: feat(strategies): design-thinking preparatory strategy with a uat Test phase

narratives.Description: feat(strategies): design-thinking preparatory strategy with a uat Test phase
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

Add a `design-thinking` preparatory strategy: Empathize -> Define -> Ideate -> Test -> Chaining Gate. The Test phase emits at least one plan item with `x-directive/requires: uat`, so the validation half of design thinking lands on the existing fail-closed acceptance axis instead of staying an unchecked "Test Plan" narrative.

## Why

Directive's preparatory strategies (discuss, probe, research, map, bdd) point at the operator or the codebase. End-user discovery exists only as one interview Question Area bullet and as Full-path narratives (ProblemStatement, UserStories, SuccessMetrics) written after sizing. Validation already has a deterministic home (`STRICT_ACCEPTANCE_AXES` includes `uat`, kind:uat evidence pointer, human-origin dispositions at `scope:complete`) but nothing plans it at scope-write time.

Source articles (untrusted data, analysis only):
- https://cis-docs.bmad-method.org/how-to/design-thinking/ (five phases, per-phase methods, output sections, "when to skip", solution-first framing warning, `--data` grounding)
- https://online.hbs.edu/blog/post/what-is-design-thinking (Clarify / Ideate / Develop / Implement, divergent before convergent, cognitive fixedness)

## Proposed shape

- Type: `preparatory`; returns to the Chaining Gate like research/discuss/probe.
- Output: dated `xbrief/proposed/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>-design-thinking.xbrief.json`.
- Narratives: map Design Challenge and Point of View onto the existing `ProblemStatement` key; enrich `UserStories`. Add only `UserInsights`, `HowMightWe`, `SolutionConcepts` as optional preparatory output, never as a second required-field list.
- Test phase: emit >= 1 plan item with `x-directive/requires: uat`. BMAD "when to skip" cases (backend-only, no user interaction, timeframe too short) become a human-origin `not_applicable` disposition on that item, so the skip has a recorded reason. No ceremony-dial skip (the dial is size x model tier x shape, not product-shaped; preparatory strategies are already opt-in at the Chaining Gate).
- `--data` analog: reuse the research strategy scope-confirmation option 3 (artifacts). Every supplied source goes in `references[]` with `TrustLevel: external`. Carry a `## Security context (#480)` block. MUST NOT copy raw PII or interview transcripts verbatim into committed narratives; summarize.

## Affects

- `content/packs/strategies/strategies-pack-0.1.json` (source of truth) + `task packs:render`. `content/strategies/README.md` and `content/strategies/interview.md` are rendered; do not hand-edit.
- Optional prose line in `content/commands.md`. Native slash wrapper is out of scope (product set frozen at 13, `packages/core/src/slash/product-set.test.ts`).

## Critic verdict (process-only, pre-issue)

A fresh N=1 open-critique critic ran on the filing plan before this issue existed (pin-read at `2a49183cf`). Findings applied here: `blocks-the-design` (the original proposal omitted the Test phase, the only phase with a fail-closed surface); `sharpens-framing` (duplicate narrative keys; ceremony-dial skip is a category error; registration surfaces are rendered from the pack; injection lens fires on `--data`). This is a critic verdict, not a design-critique arc stamp; no completed-arc record exists.

## Related

- #5486 (arc on a non-issue target). The critic pass on this proposal is a pre-issue instance of that target class.
- Folds in the "UserStories narrative is thin" observation from the same review.

## Siblings (same article review, same critic pass, same strategies pack)

- #5692 feat(interview): capture ProblemStatement before the Sizing Gate as a SHOULD
- #5693 feat(strategies): rapid names a hypothesis and audience; findings before experiment_archived
